{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-wnas","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: SCHC ACK bitmap omits received tiles for corrupted-All-1 RCS failure path","description":"The SCHC fragmentation test shared_vectors_drive_production_implementations fails with rcs_failure_ack mismatch:

  expected: 780000 (n=0, all 63 bits are trailing-ones = all tiles considered received)
  actual: 78003e8000000000000000 (n=62, FCN 62=1, FCN 61=0, FCNs 60-1=0, FCN 0=1 trailing)

The test exercises: receive FCN 62 and FCN 61 (two regular tiles), then receive a corrupted All-1 that fails RCS. After correction, the receiver should report FCN 62=1, FCN 61=1, and FCNs 0-60=1 (since they were never sent). With all 63 bits as 1, n should be 0 (no bits before trailing ones).

The actual output marks FCN 61 as 0 (not received) even though it was received before the corrupted All-1. This indicates the bitmap serialization in Ack::write_to is not correctly reflecting the receiver's internal state.
